newsitem.title: UK: Pakistan's HUBCO plant fully operational.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's HUBCO plant fully operational.

text.p: Pakistan's Hub Power Company Ltd said on Wednesday its plant near Karachi had been completed ahead of schedule and within its original budget.

Hubco, which called itself Pakistan's largest company, said in a statement released in London that the $1.5 billion plant was now in full commercial operation, supplying 1,200 megawatts to Pakistan's electricity grid.
Hubco said Britain's National Power and Saudi Arabia's Xenel were the biggest shareholders in Hubco. National Power holds a 26 percent stake, Hubco said.
The plant is an oil-fired, thermal power plant 40 kilometres north-west of Karachi.
